name: testing
description: Verification guidance prioritizing critical user journeys and failure cases over superficial line coverage.
guidelines: Test the highest-risk user journey end-to-end at the application boundary where feasible.
Include negative tests for auth, validation and ownership boundaries.
Do not substitute syntax success for functional verification.
definition_of_done: Critical routes/functions have deterministic automated coverage where the project test runtime is enabled.
At minimum, local parse checks and health probes pass before launch.
